title: onchain-cert-eval-paper-repro: Reproduction package for on-chain behavior-based competency certification
description: Reproduction package for the paper "A Third-Party Reproducible Framework for On-Chain Behavior-Based Competency Certification" (제3자 재현 검증이 가능한 온체인 행위 기반 역량 인증 프레임워크). Contains the evaluation pipeline core, the rule sets used in the experiments, the Experiment 1-4 scripts, frozen real transaction-hash datasets, result CSVs, and read-only on-chain verification evidence for the deployment facts quoted in the paper.
